lines.zh: 我浮在离地一寸的地方前进。
lines.en: I advance an inch above the ground.
My boots barely touch the soil.
I walk the ridge line, footing sure.

lines.zh: 我绕过一片碎石，没有减速。
lines.en: I skirt a scree field without slowing.

lines.zh: 空气里有尘土，我不喜欢。
lines.en: There is dust in the air. I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我每走十步就扫一眼地平线。
lines.en: Every ten steps I sweep the horizon.
My cape trails an arc behind me.

lines.zh: 我踏上一块高石，居高看了一圈。
lines.en: I step onto a high rock and look around from above.

lines.zh: 这片地形太平，没有遮蔽。
lines.en: This ground is too flat. No cover.
I move lower, where the wind is less.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了一下扬起的沙。
lines.en: I raise a hand against the blowing sand.
My pace is not fast, but it never falters.
I stand with my arms crossed.

lines.zh: 我在估算这片区域的气。
lines.en: I am measuring the ki in this area.

lines.zh: 风把我的披风吹到一边。
lines.en: The wind pulls my cape to one side.
One second of closed eyes, and my power rises.
My heartbeat is slow.
Namekian ground sits hard underfoot.
I am holding my ki down.

lines.zh: 这副姿态，是给对手看的。
lines.en: This posture is for my opponent to see.
I reach up and press the back of my neck.
Clouds move far off, slowly.
I am not used to waiting like this.

lines.zh: 我在压低气，等一个好时机。
lines.en: I keep my ki low and wait for the right moment.
There is blood on the wind, faint.

lines.zh: 那美克星的沙，踩着不结实。
lines.en: Namekian sand gives way underfoot.

lines.zh: 你的战斗力，我看得出来。
lines.en: I can read your battle power.
Too low. Laughably low.
I lift my chin and look down at you.
You do not look like this planet's people.

lines.zh: 我扫了你一眼，已经够了。
lines.en: One glance is enough.
You are trembling. Why?
I am not here to make friends.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛里有不甘，我懂。
lines.en: There is defiance in your eyes. I know it.

lines.zh: 你的战斗力，低得没必要说。
lines.en: Your power level is too low to even mention.
If you mean to strike, do it.

lines.zh: 我抬起下巴，你就该让路。
lines.en: I lift my chin, and you should clear the way.
Do not put on airs before me.

lines.zh: 你的姿势，我一眼就看穿了。
lines.en: I see through your stance at a glance.

lines.zh: 我有一件事要办，别拦我。
lines.en: I have business here. Do not stand in my way.
Clear a path.

lines.zh: 你还不配知道我的名字。
lines.en: You are not yet worth my name.
I have your ki memorized.
Next time, do not stand in front of me.
I grunt and give one step.

lines.zh: 红土沾了我一身，血也是。
lines.en: The red soil is all over me — so is the blood.
I spit blood onto the ground.

lines.zh: 那美克星的红土，沾了我一身。
lines.en: Namek's red dust is all over me.

lines.zh: 我压住肋侧，把气重新提起来。
lines.en: I clamp my ribs and raise my ki again.
Ki remains. Strength remains.

lines.zh: 那美克星的空气，让伤口更疼。
lines.en: The Namekian air makes the wound sting more.
My power level is twenty-four thousand.
But only that.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，把这口气咽了回去。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and swallow it down.

lines.zh: 那东西跟你一样没价值。
lines.en: That thing is as worthless as you.
I do not eat what strangers offer.
I did not even look at it.
A Saiyan does not take charity.
Put it away. I am not interested.
I have not moved a step.
If that were a senzu bean, perhaps.
Pity it is not a senzu bean.
You raise the food. I laugh.

lines.zh: 这种东西留着喂你自己。
lines.en: Keep that to feed yourself.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，像撞到铁。
lines.en: You strike me as if striking iron.
My stance has not changed.
I step aside to avoid you.
Do not block the road.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞连灰尘都没扬起。
lines.en: That bump did not even raise dust.
I put a hand out and hold you still.
You have stepped on my cape.
Three paces back from me.

lines.zh: 我的披风被你踩住了，让开。
lines.en: You're standing on my cape — move.
Once more and I will respond.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的王子不谈这些。
lines.en: A Saiyan prince does not speak of such things.
I have no such intention.
My mind is elsewhere.
I look away.
Such things make one weak.
I stand perfectly still.
I once had other ties.

lines.zh: 我把视线移开，不再多说。
lines.en: I look away and say no more.
I pull my cape straight.
Do not ask about this.

lines.zh: 我低头看了一眼，捡起来。
lines.en: I glance down and pick it up.
What is this supposed to be?
I hold it up between two fingers.
Not needed. Discard.

lines.zh: 这个我带走，那美克星的战利品归我。
lines.en: I will take this; Namek's spoils are mine.
Yours. Catch.
Too light. No weight at all.
I tuck it at my waist.

lines.zh: 那美克星的战斗力，两万四。
lines.en: Twenty-four thousand on Namek.
Never mind. Useless.

lines.zh: 你的气动了，我察觉到了。
lines.en: Your ki moved. I felt it.
I turn and face you squarely.

lines.zh: 战斗力不高，但我有点兴趣。
lines.en: Battle power is low, but I am a little interested.
Let me see how long you last.
I raise my hand.
Not far. One step.
I do not shout. Shouting is surplus.

lines.zh: 你气一动，我就转过身来。
lines.en: One flicker of your ki and I turn around.
Do not think I will hold back.
This is only the beginning.

lines.zh: 靴底刚离地，我已经到你面前。
lines.en: My boots barely leave the ground before I'm on you.
The light in my palm is short but steady.
Retreat now while you still can.
But you do not.

lines.zh: 我一抬脚，气已经贴上你的脸。
lines.en: One lift of my boot and my ki is already against your face.
I will remember this moment.

lines.zh: 我在等你的第一个动作。
lines.en: I wait for your first move.
You step left; I close it first.
The ki in my palm never dims.
A ki blast forms in my palm.
Your opening is the knee.
I am calculating your limit.
Your breathing grows louder.
I need not hurry. You will not last.
This ground offers no cover.
Five steps left — you can count them.
Five paces of distance left.
I level my palm at you.
Your eyes are hunting an escape route.

lines.zh: 你的破绽在膝盖，我看清了。
lines.en: Your weakness is at the knee — I've seen it.
At three I strike.
One last beat of time.
Strike now.
Do not blink.
My fist drives into your side.

lines.zh: 你被击退，脚下犁出两道痕。
lines.en: You are driven back, boots plowing two furrows.
I come down with a heel from above.
A knife hand lands on your shoulder.
The shockwave lifts all the gravel.

lines.zh: 你挡住了一下，手腕在抖。
lines.en: You block one; your wrist shakes.
I seize you and throw.

lines.zh: 我一拳打在你腹侧，收着力。
lines.en: I drive a fist into your side, holding back.

lines.zh: 你还能站起来，值得一说。
lines.en: You can still rise. Worth noting.
But the gap will not change.
I remember Namek's dust.
I shake out my fist.
Your bones are hard enough.
Once more.
This time I will not stop.
Go down.

lines.zh: 我从空中落下，落在碎石上。
lines.en: I drop from the air onto broken stone.

lines.zh: 脚下的岩面塌了一小块。
lines.en: A patch of rock gives beneath me.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看向这片陌生天空。
lines.en: I raise my eyes to this unfamiliar sky.

lines.zh: 空气干燥，像那美克星的荒地。
lines.en: The air is dry, like Namek's wastes.

lines.zh: 我按了按手腕上的护具。
lines.en: I press the guard on my wrist.
My ki is intact. Undiminished.

lines.zh: 我落在碎石上，岩面塌了一角。
lines.en: I land on rubble and a corner of rock gives way.

lines.zh: 这里的空气很干，像那美克星。
lines.en: The air here is dry, like Namek.

lines.zh: 这片地没有值得看的东西。
lines.en: Nothing here worth looking at.
Since I am here, I will look.
I raise a hand and test my ki.

lines.zh: 掌心的气吸成一点，我压住了。
lines.en: The ki in my palm pulls to a point and holds.

lines.zh: 我站了很久，才迈出第一步。
lines.en: I stand a long while before the first step.
Wind, and dust running low.
I throw my chin up.
Vegeta. Remember that name.
I will become stronger.
I have always been this way.

lines.zh: 火焰包住我，我咬牙从里面走出来。
lines.en: Fire wraps me; I step out of it through my teeth.
I am struck down into a heap of stone.

lines.zh: 水灌进肺里，我手臂乱划。
lines.en: Water fills my lungs; my arms thrash.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，我在空中转了半圈。
lines.en: The blast flips me and I spin half a turn.
An arrow sticks in my arm.

lines.zh: 异样的力量把气封住了一瞬。
lines.en: An alien force seals my ki for an instant.

lines.zh: 饿太久，气都聚不起来了。
lines.en: Too long hungry; I cannot even gather my ki.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的身体僵了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my body locks for an instant.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，我向下坠。
lines.en: Nothing beneath me. I fall.
